name: Claude Code
tagline: Anthropic's coding agent: it understands your codebase, edits files and runs commands from the terminal, your editor or the web.
about: Claude Code is an agent for software work. It reads a whole project, makes changes across files, runs commands and tests, and reports what it did.
pros: Works across a whole codebase, not only the open file.
Runs commands and tests, then fixes what fails.
Available in the terminal, in popular editors and on the web.
cons: Needs a paid Claude plan or API credits.
Heavy use can reach plan limits.
Changes still need review before merging.
